referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A founder-advisory story uses nearly black graphite, white typography, a vivid pale-lime signal, pixel-like particles, and mono micro-labels. A centered statement leads into a compact client logo rail and a framed principles system; long founder prose and differentiated client-success cards add human depth. The second half moves through a three-part partnership process, an expertise selection, a large lime conversation panel, a quieter newsletter option, and a sparse, particle-accented footer. It is deliberately specific and reflective rather than a generic professional-services card template.

heroGeometry.mode: centered typographic founder promise with sparse pixel field and one small action
heroGeometry.alignment: centered title and summary; broad negative space separates it from the next proof rail
heroGeometry.viewport: the audience, founder role, and conversation action are stated before the long essay

navigationGeometry.mode: small wordmark and compact text links with a single conversation action
navigationGeometry.placement: thin top edge above a centered hero
navigationGeometry.mobile: condense links into a tap-safe menu and preserve one direct call action

typography.display: modern geometric sans with pixel/mono micro-labels
typography.scale: large centered promise, medium essay lines, tiny labels used as navigation rather than body text

palette.contrastIntent: lime marks selected ideas and conversion; body copy remains white/gray with accessible contrast

imageTreatment.mode: sparse pixel particles, restrained founder/client evidence, and minimal line symbols
imageTreatment.crop: mostly typographic sections with a few inset video/proof cards
imageTreatment.focalPoint: the principle or client progress story currently being explained

servicePresentation.pattern: expertise options as three distinct advisory roles supported by principle and process
servicePresentation.interaction: simple, labeled choices leading to a verified inquiry or relevant detail

ctaPlacement.primary: Book or request a verified introductory conversation
ctaPlacement.early: small conversation action in the header/hero; large CTA follows the expertise explanation

motion.primitive: slow, sparse pixel-field drift and a scroll-led sequence that marks principles/progress
motion.library: CSS/native scroll reveals or a restrained GSAP sequence
motion.reducedMotion: freeze particle field and show all principles and client evidence in natural order

mobileRecomposition.strategy: single-column reflective essay with stacked proof and process
rules: stack the principles and client-progress cards with clear labels
preserve generous but not empty vertical rhythm
keep the lime CTA full-width and readable
do not present client logos or testimonials without verified consent

prohibitedPatterns: copying founder claims, quotations, framework names, client logos, video, testimonials, or lime brand trade dress
turning the page into a dark bento dashboard
unverified coaching outcomes or client results
excessive blank space that hides missing proof
newsletter competing with the primary consultation CTA

requiredSignatureElements.description: a distinctive principles or decision framework described in the client's own terms
permissioned evidence about client progress or an honest alternative process proof
high-signal conversation invitation after the service/expertise explanation

acceptanceChecks: hero identifies who the advisor helps and what first conversation means
principle and service framework come from verified client intake
